title: Made a  blizzard survival game with Opus 5.5. 1 html file with no assets
author: ResidentHyperMan112
selftext:
Long Story Short. Most of what i do is create games that use the body or phone as the controller. I've been wanting to dig deeper on what I could do more in just Claude. I saw this super life-like ocean simulator and wanted to see if I could do something similar and how "lifelike" it could be. Took about 18 passes and 463k tokens to reach what I currently have.

You’re stuck in a blizzard and have to find a cabin before the snow covers your screen. The wind pushes you off course and you can brace against it, but it drains your stamina.

Don't know if I can post the link so people can play it here, but here is a video.
